issues.t: Front lower ball joints can wear and separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front end over bumps, wandering steering, or uneven tire wear.
issues.why: The front lower ball joints could wear faster than normal and eventually pull apart, letting the wheel collapse. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If the front end clunks or steering feels loose, stop driving and have it towed for inspection.

issues.t: Ignition switch contacts can wear and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine cuts out while driving, the dash lights flicker, or the van will not start.
issues.why: Worn electrical contacts inside the ignition switch can interrupt power and stall the engine. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the switch replaced. Do not rely on the van in traffic until it is fixed.

issues.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The ignition key can be removed without the shifter in Park.
issues.why: A worn ignition switch could let the key come out while the transmission is not in Park, so the van could roll away. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Always confirm the shifter is in Park and set the parking brake before leaving the van.

issues.t: Throttle can freeze open in cold, wet weather (recall)
issues.sym: The engine keeps revving or the van does not slow when you lift off the gas in freezing, wet conditions.
issues.why: Water could get into the throttle linkage and freeze, holding the throttle open. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If the throttle sticks, shift to Neutral, brake firmly and pull over, and have the van towed.

issues.t: Sliding doors may not latch fully (recalls)
issues.sym: A door-ajar light, a sliding door that looks closed but is not latched, or a power door lock that is slow to engage.
issues.why: Latch adjustment problems, and on some 1999 vans excess grease slowing the lock actuator, could leave a sliding door unlatched. It could open while driving. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Make sure children are belted and the door-ajar light is off before driving.

issues.t: Underhood wiring can rub and blow a fuse (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of some electrical features, or warning lights caused by a blown fuse.
issues.why: An underhood wiring harness could rub against a metal pipe until the insulation wore through and shorted. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the harness inspected and protected.

issues.t: Instrument panel dimmer can fail (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge lights go dark or cannot be adjusted at night.
issues.why: The dash dimmer control could fail and leave the gauges hard to read in the dark. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the dimmer replaced.

issues.t: Automatic transmission can slip or fail (warranty extension)
issues.sym: Slipping out of gear, gears that will not engage, sudden hard downshifts, or the transmission refusing to shift.
issues.why: A bearing inside the transmission could break up, or a third-gear clutch part could wear early and spread metal debris through the case. Honda extended transmission coverage on 2000-2001 vans after many failures, and 1999 owners report the same pattern.
issues.next: Have the transmission checked right away if it slips or will not shift, as it can leave you stranded. Use only genuine Honda fluid and keep up with fluid changes.

issues.t: Water pump pulley misalignment can damage the timing belt (recall)
issues.sym: A whine or chirp from the front of the engine, or a sudden stall.
issues.why: A misaligned water pump pulley could wear the timing belt until it failed, stopping the engine and possibly damaging it. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If you hear new noises from the timing belt area, have the van inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Transmission second gear can overheat and lock up (recall)
issues.sym: Harsh or slipping shifts, a flashing D light, or in the worst case the transmission locking up and the front wheels skidding.
issues.why: Second gear inside the automatic transmission could overheat from poor lubrication and break, which may lock the transmission. Honda recalled affected vans to add an oil jet kit and inspect the gear.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away. If the D light flashes or shifting changes, have it checked before more driving, and use only Honda fluid.

issues.t: Fuel tank can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell or fuel dripping near the tank.
issues.why: Imperfections in the surface of some fuel tanks could let fuel seep out, a fire risk. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for open recalls and have the tank inspected.

issues.t: Air bags can deploy without a crash (recall)
issues.sym: An air bag warning light, or in rare cases an air bag going off while driving.
issues.why: Electrical noise in the air bag control system could make the bags deploy when they should not. Honda recalled affected vans to add a noise suppressor.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the fix done promptly.

issues.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The key can be pulled from the ignition with the shifter outside Park.
issues.why: A lever in the ignition interlock can bend, defeating the safeguard that keeps the key in until the van is in Park. The van could roll away. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Always confirm Park and set the parking brake before leaving the van.

issues.t: Fuel pump can lose power and stall the engine (recalls)
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving or cranks but will not start.
issues.why: Several recalls covered fuel pump power loss: corroded pump terminals on 2004 vans, and on 2005 vans a loose fuse box terminal and a fuel pump relay coil wire that could break.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Do not rely on the van in traffic if it has stalled until it has been checked.

issues.t: Front impact sensors can corrode (recall)
issues.sym: An air bag warning light on the dash.
issues.why: Water could get into the front crash sensors and corrode them, so the front air bags might not work in a crash. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the sensors replaced.

issues.t: Steering column may be assembled wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Steering feels loose, notchy or unusual.
issues.why: Some steering columns were assembled incorrectly at the factory, which could affect steering control. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Stop driving and have it towed if steering feels loose.

issues.t: Rear wheel speed sensors may be installed wrong (recall)
issues.sym: ABS or stability control warning lights.
issues.why: Incorrectly installed rear wheel speed sensors can disable anti-lock brakes and stability control. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the sensors corrected.

issues.t: Power liftgate struts can wear and let it drop (recall)
issues.sym: The liftgate drifts down or will not stay open.
issues.why: The gas struts could wear early and let the liftgate close unexpectedly on someone. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and do not stand under the liftgate until the struts are replaced.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A soft or sinking brake pedal, low brake fluid, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: Brake fluid without a certain additive could dry out a master cylinder seal, letting fluid leak and reducing braking. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If the pedal sinks or the brake light is on, do not drive until it is fixed.

issues.t: Fuel pump strainer cover can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell, especially after filling up.
issues.why: The cover on the fuel pump strainer could deteriorate and crack, letting fuel leak from the top of the tank. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for open recalls and have the part replaced.

issues.t: Power sliding doors stick, stop partway or reopen
issues.sym: A power sliding door that stops midway, binds, rattles, reverses after closing, or will not latch.
issues.why: Worn or dirty door rollers, tired latch parts and stretched cables make the door motor work too hard, so the safety system stops or reverses the door.
issues.next: Have the rollers, track and latch cleaned or replaced. Do not drive with a door that is not fully latched.

issues.t: Transmission judder, harsh downshifts or flashing D light
issues.sym: A shudder at light throttle, the transmission holding a high gear on hills, harsh downshifts, or a flashing D light with a check engine light.
issues.why: Aging or neglected fluid and torque converter problems can cause judder and poor shifting. Honda dealers often fixed this with fluid service, a software update, or a new torque converter.
issues.next: Have the fluid checked and changed with Honda fluid, and ask about software updates. If the D light flashes or the van slips, get it inspected before more driving.

issues.t: Oil burning and misfires on engines with cylinder deactivation (VCM)
issues.sym: Check engine light with misfire codes, a rough or shaky idle, oil level dropping between changes, and oil-fouled spark plugs.
issues.why: On V6 engines that shut off cylinders to save fuel (VCM), the piston rings on the resting cylinders can stick with carbon, so oil gets into those cylinders and fouls the plugs. A class action led Honda to extend engine coverage for misfires and oil use on many of these vans.
issues.next: Check the oil level often and top it up. Have misfires diagnosed promptly, since unburned fuel can damage the catalytic converter. Ask a Honda dealer about piston ring repairs or goodwill coverage.

issues.t: Stability control can brake on its own or cause a soft pedal (recalls)
issues.sym: The van brakes or pulls unexpectedly with no one pressing the pedal, or the brake pedal feels soft.
issues.why: Two recalls covered the stability control (VSA) system: one fault could make it apply brakes unexpectedly, and air trapped in the VSA unit could make the pedal soft.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away and have both fixes done. Have the van checked before more driving if it brakes on its own.

issues.t: Power liftgate struts can lose pressure (recall)
issues.sym: The liftgate drifts down or will not stay up.
issues.why: The liftgate gas struts could leak and lose strength, so the liftgate might close on someone. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and do not stand under the liftgate until the struts are replaced.

issues.t: Wrong front brake hoses can rub and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A soft pedal, brake fluid on the inside of a front wheel, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: Incorrect front brake hoses could touch a caliper bolt and wear through, leaking brake fluid. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Do not drive if the pedal is soft or fluid is leaking.

issues.t: Windshield wiper linkage can bend when wipers are frozen (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers move out of sync or stop working.
issues.why: Running the wipers while frozen to the glass could bend or disconnect the linkage rod. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Clear ice before using the wipers and do not drive in rain or snow if they stop working.

issues.t: Front power window can come off track or shatter (recall)
issues.sym: A grinding sound from the door, a window that jams, or broken glass.
issues.why: The front door window could come off its track and break. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the window regulator inspected.

issues.t: Driver air bag module may be missing rivets (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms in normal driving.
issues.why: Some driver air bag modules were built without all their rivets, so the bag may not deploy properly. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the module replaced.

issues.t: Second-row seats may not lock and can tip forward (recalls)
issues.sym: A second-row seat or seatback that moves or rocks when pushed, or tips forward under braking.
issues.why: Several recalls found second-row seats that might not latch after being adjusted or folded, so a seat could tip forward in hard braking. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. After moving a seat, pull on it to make sure it is locked, and keep children out of any seat that will not lock.

issues.t: VCM spool valve gasket leaks oil onto the alternator
issues.sym: Oil seeping down the front of the engine, a burning oil smell, and later charging problems, a dead battery or a failed alternator.
issues.why: The gaskets on the oil control (spool) valve for the cylinder deactivation system harden and leak. The oil runs down onto the alternator below it and can ruin it.
issues.next: Have the spool valve gaskets replaced as soon as you see a leak at the front of the engine. If the alternator has failed, fix the leak too, or the new one can fail the same way.

issues.t: Front strut bolt nut may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or knock from a front corner over bumps.
issues.why: The nut on a front damper bolt may not have been tightened enough and could come loose, affecting handling. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Have it inspected before more driving if you hear clunks from the front.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake in cold weather (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter can be moved out of Park without pressing the brake pedal in cold temperatures.
issues.why: The shift interlock could react slowly in the cold, so the van might move unexpectedly when the shifter is bumped. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Keep your foot on the brake when shifting and set the parking brake when parked.

issues.t: Soft pistons can wear and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Engine knocking, rough running, or a stall.
issues.why: Some pistons may not have been hard enough and could wear early, leading to engine damage or stalling. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Stop driving and have the engine checked if it knocks or runs rough.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recalls)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, will not start, or stalls while driving.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can fail, which can stall the engine at speed. Honda recalled a wide range of these vans, with earlier recalls for some 2018-2020 vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the pump replaced. Do not rely on the van in traffic if it has stalled or run rough.

issues.t: Side curtain air bag connector may be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: An air bag warning light.
issues.why: A shorting terminal on the side curtain air bag could be damaged during assembly, which may stop the bag from working. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have it repaired.

issues.t: Fuel tank welds can separate and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell or fuel dripping near the tank.
issues.why: Welds on some fuel tanks could crack open and leak fuel, a fire risk. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for open recalls and have the tank replaced.

issues.t: Third-row center seat belt may not latch (recall)
issues.sym: The third-row center belt does not stay buckled.
issues.why: The tongue of the third-row center belt might not latch securely. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and keep passengers out of that seat until it is fixed.

issues.t: Battery fault can shift the van into Park while moving (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights, a sudden shift into Park, or the van will not shift out of Park.
issues.why: On these vans a weak battery or poor battery terminal connection could make the electronic shifter select Park unexpectedly, which can damage the parking pawl and leave the van able to roll when parked.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the battery and software checked. Set the parking brake every time you park.

issues.t: Rear brake caliper pistons can reduce braking (recall)
issues.sym: A longer, softer brake pedal or the van taking longer to stop.
issues.why: A coating problem on the rear caliper pistons could let gas pockets form in the brake fluid, reducing braking power. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If the pedal feels soft, have the brakes checked before more driving.

issues.t: Connecting rod bearings can wear and seize (recall)
issues.sym: Engine knocking, low oil pressure warning, or a sudden loss of power.
issues.why: Some connecting rod bearings could wear out early and seize, which can destroy the engine and stall it while driving. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls now. If you hear knocking, stop driving and have the van towed.

issues.t: 9-speed automatic shifts roughly or jerks (TSB)
issues.sym: Harsh or jerky upshifts at steady acceleration, delayed engagement, banging into gear, hesitation, and sometimes a check engine light.
issues.why: Vans with the 9-speed automatic (mainly lower trims) have shift logic problems. Honda issued service bulletins, including A19-124, with software updates for harsh shifts.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer whether the transmission software updates have been done. If shifting stays rough or the van hesitates in traffic, have it inspected.

issues.t: Power sliding door may not latch (recalls)
issues.sym: A door-ajar warning, a sliding door that reverses or will not close fully, or one that looks shut but is not latched.
issues.why: Sticky latch assemblies and outer handle cables that can freeze could leave a sliding door unlatched, so it might open while driving. Honda recalled affected vans twice.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Make sure the door-ajar light is off before driving and keep children belted.

issues.t: Third-row power outlet wiring can short (recall)
issues.sym: The rear power outlet stops working, or a burning smell from the third-row area.
issues.why: The wiring for the third-row power outlet could be pinched and short out, which can overheat. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Stop using the outlet and check your VIN for open recalls. Pull over and turn the van off if you smell burning.

issues.t: Front seat belt buckle may not latch (recall)
issues.sym: The belt tongue does not click in, or pulls back out.
issues.why: The release button on some front seat belt buckles could keep the belt from latching. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and tug the belt after buckling to make sure it is locked.

issues.t: Side and curtain air bags can deploy unexpectedly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning.
issues.why: A software error can fire the side and curtain air bags when there is no crash. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the software updated promptly.

issues.t: Backup camera image or gauges can disappear (recalls)
issues.sym: The rearview camera picture is blank, delayed or distorted, or the gauges and screen go dark.
issues.why: Several recalls covered this generation: software errors in the instrument panel and media network, water getting into the camera, and a faulty camera video cable connector.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the software or camera fixed. Use mirrors and look behind you when backing up.

issues.t: Passenger seat weight sensor faults (recalls)
issues.sym: The passenger air bag off light behaves oddly, or an air bag warning light comes on.
issues.why: The passenger seat weight sensor can crack or short, so the passenger air bag may switch off when it should be on, or deploy when it should not.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the sensor replaced. Seat children in the rear seats.

issues.t: Timing belt teeth can separate (recall)
issues.sym: A slapping noise, then a stall or a no-start.
issues.why: Teeth on some timing belts could come apart, letting the belt slip and stall the engine. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the belt inspected or replaced before more driving.

issues.t: Air bag control unit may not deploy the bags (recall)
issues.sym: An air bag warning light, or no symptoms.
issues.why: A software error in the air bag control unit could stop air bags and seat belt pretensioners from firing in a crash. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the unit updated.

issues.t: Side mirror glass can fall out (recall)
issues.sym: Mirror glass that is loose, rattles, or is missing.
issues.why: The heating pad behind the mirror glass may not be bonded well, so the glass can detach. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the mirror glass replaced.

issues.t: Second-row seat rails may not lock (recall)
issues.sym: A second-row seat slides or does not stay locked in place.
issues.why: The rail locks on second-row seats could deform and fail to lock, so the seat could move in a crash. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Keep children out of a seat that will not lock until it is fixed.

issues.t: Tire can slowly lose air from a pinhole (recall)
issues.sym: A tire pressure warning light or a tire that keeps going low.
issues.why: Some tires had a pinhole that could cause a slow leak. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the affected tire replaced. Keep tires at the correct pressure until then.

issues.t: Water can corrode and bind the steering gear (recall)
issues.sym: Steering feels heavy, sticky or notchy, especially after rain or washing.
issues.why: Water can get into the steering gear and cause corrosion, making steering bind. Honda recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away. If the steering binds or feels unusual, do not drive until it is checked.

issues.t: Driver air bag inflator can rupture or underinflate (recalls)
issues.sym: Nothing is noticeable in normal driving; the danger only appears when the bag fires.
issues.why: These inflators can take in moisture over the years, which can make them burst or fill the bag too weakly.
issues.next: Check the VIN with Honda now and have the inflator replaced free; follow any do-not-drive advice they give.

issues.t: Wheelchair restraint retractors may not lock (recall)
issues.sym: A secured wheelchair can still shift or roll while the van is moving.
issues.why: Retractors in certain aftermarket wheelchair restraint kits fitted to converted vans may not lock as intended.
issues.next: If your van has a wheelchair restraint system, get the free inspection and retractor replacement before carrying a passenger.
